buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms & Condition of the Bid Procurement of Microsoft Planner and Project Plan 3 for A SU- PAC 1. This procurement is being undertaken on a Proprietary Article PAC basi s. Accordingly, only the OEM or its duly authorized representative/reseller s hall be eligible to participate in the bid. Authorized Resellers shall submit a valid Authorization Certificate issued by the OEM, specifically mentioning the Bid Reference Number and providing the name and contact details of the OEM for verification purposes. (PAC Certificated attached in ATC) 2. Contractual Experience: Successful completion as main supplier wit hin the last five (5) years (upto the last date of submission of bids), of at le ast one (01) contract with minimum value of INR 7,25,000.00 with nature and complexity similar to the scope of supply. OR Successful completion as main supplier within the last five (5) years (upto t he last date of submission of bids) of atleast two (02) contracts with minimu m value of INR 5,44,000.00 each with nature, and complexity similar to th e scope of supply described in scope of supply. OR Successful completion as main supplier within the last five (5) years (upto t he last date of submission of bids) of atleast three (03) contracts with mini mum value of INR 3,63,000.00 each with nature, and complexity similar t o the scope of supply described in scope of supply. The contract should have been awarded by central/ state govt body /institutes or public sector undertaking etc. Bidder is required to su bmit Purchase orders and Completion certificates from the

previous purchaser as a proof. 3. Size of Operation (Average Annual Turnover): Minimum average an nual turnover of INR 13,60,000.00 calculated as total payments received by the Bidder for contracts completed or under execution over the last 3 years. The bidder should submit a CA certified Turnover Certificate with v alid UDIN. 4. Financial Position: Bidder’s net worth for the last year, calculated as the difference between total assets and total liabilities, should be positive. Submission of audited financial statements or, if not required by the law of the Bidder’s country, other financial statements acceptable to the Purchase r, for the last three (03) Financial years i.e FY 2022-23, FY 203-24 & FY 2024-25 to demonstrate the current soundness of the Bidder’s financial position. 5. Bid Security: The Bidder shall submit Bid Security amounting Rs 9,00 0.00 (Rupees Seven Thousand & Three Hundred) only in the form Bank Gu arantee/ DD/ FDR. (Bank Guarantee Formant is attached in ATC) Name of Account - ASSAM SKILL UNIVERSITY PROJECT Bank name: HDFC Bank Account no.: 50100760328341 IFSC: HDF C0004678 (Format of BG is attached in ATC document) DD/ FDR to be made in favor of Chief Executive Officer, Assam Skill University Project under Assam S kill University Payable at Guwahati. 6. Performance Security: The Supplier shall provide a Performance Securit y of 5 (%) percent of the Contract Price. The forms of acceptable Performance Security are Bank guarantee issued by a reputable bank located in India. Performance Security shall be discharged by the Purchaser and returned to the Supplier not later th an 15 days following the date of completion of the Supplier’s performance obligations under warrant y and maintenance of the supplied software. Bank Guarantee shall be prepared with following details: Name of Account - ASSAM SKILL UNIVERSITY PROJECT Bank name: HDFC Bank Account no.: 50100760328341 IFSC: HDF C0004678 (Format of PBG is attached in ATC document)

a. The successful bidder shall have to deposit a Bank Guarantee (in the format attached in Additional Terms & Conditions of the bid document) as Performance Security, within ten (10) working days of iss uance of acceptance, for an amount of equivalent to 5% of the contract value only issued by any Nati onalized/ Scheduled Bank in India, with validity as mentioned in the bid. b. The bidder’s Performance Security will be discharged after completion of bidder’s performance obli gations under the contract. c. If the successful bidder fails to submit the Performance Security within ten (10) days from the date of issue of Notification of Award by the employer, the Notification of award may be cancelled by the CEO, ASUP and in that event, the contract may be awarded to the next ranked successful bidder. d. The Performance Security, either whole or any part, may be forfeited by the employer if the succes sful bidder/ service provider neglects any of his obligations under the contract, as compensation for a ny loss resulting from such failure. e. In case of failure of the Service Provider to commence work or in the event of breach of any of the t erms of the Contract, the Performance Security of the Service Provider may be forfeited. The client, af ter cancellation of the Contract, gets the work done through any other Service Provider for the remai ning term of the Contract at the risk and costs of the Service Provider. f. The Performance Security, either whole or any part, may be forfeited by the client if the successful bidder/ service provider neglects any of his obligations under the contract, as compensation for any l oss resulting from such failure. 7. Exemption: MSME Bidders are exempted from submitting Bid Security , provided they submit a valid Udyam Registration Certificate containing a relevant NIC code applicable to the service/item being procured. No exemption shall be allowed in respect of the Average Annual Turnover, requisite experience, or any other eligibility criteria specified in the Bidding Document. MSME bidders shall also be required to furnish Performance Sec urity, wherever applicable, in accordance with the provisions of the Bidding Document. 8. Mandatory Requirement from Supplier: a. Implementation: The vendor will assist for implementing the softwar e platform, ensuring the seamless integration, functionality and user trai ning. b. Training of Student and Technical Staff: The vendor will provide adv anced training programs for Assam Skill University's faculty and technic al staff. 9. Payment Terms: 100% within 60 days from receipt by the Purchase r of the delivered software on site, installation, training and after satisfac tory acceptance in accordance with the contract (or whatever is appropri ate for the goods being procured) including the required documents. 10. Scope of Supply: The Supplier shall deliver, install and Commission the software at Assam Skill University Campus, Mangaldoi, Assam. Installation an d commissioning of software and the cost for the same shall be considered in quoting the rates. 11. Liquidated Damages: The applicable rate for liquidated damages fo r delay shall be: 1 % per week or part thereof, maximum amount shall be 10% of the contract price. 12. Technical Compliance: Bidders need to fill the technical Compliance form and submit the same along with the bid as per the format provided i n ATC. 13. Fraud and Corruption: This Contract shall be covered by the provisi ons of ADB’s Anticorruption Policy (1998, as amended to date) and Integri

ty Principles and Guidelines (2015, as amended from time to time) that re quires Borrowers (including beneficiaries of ADB-financed activity), as well as Suppliers and Contractors under ADB-financed contracts, to observe th e highest standard of ethics during the procurement and execution of suc h contracts 14. Termination Due to Integrity Violation : The Purchaser may termi nate this Contract, in whole or in part, if the Supplier, in the judgment of t he Purchaser has engaged in integrity violations in accordance with Claus e 12 [Fraud and Corruption], in competing for or in executing this Contrac t 15. Accounts and Records: The Supplier shall keep accurate and syste matic accounts and records in respect of the delivered goods in such form and detail as are customary in the industry, for a period of no less than 3 years after the expiration or termination of this Contract. 16. Suspension of ADB Loan or Credit: 17.1 In the event that ADB suspends the Loan or Credit to the Purchas er, from which part of the payments to the Supplier are being made a) the Purchaser is obligated to notify the Supplier, with copy to the Pu rchaser’s representative, of such suspension within 7 days of having re ceived ADB’s suspension notice. b) if the Supplier has not received sums due it within the 28 days for p ayment provided for in contract, the Supplier may immediately issue a 14-day termination notice 17. Bidders are required to fill the Self–Undertaking for Payment of Statut ory Taxes as per format given in the ATC Document. 18. Delivery, Installation and Training Schedule: 60 Days from the date of Signing of the Contract. 19. Governing Law and Jurisdiction: This agreement shall be governed by a nd construed in accordance with the laws of India, and any disputes shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in Guwahati." 20. ATC condition will supersede all other conditions if any. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
